pages.text: The $(item)Star Anvil$() repairs and enhances equipment using $(mana)mana$().$(br2)$(l)How to use:$()$(br)$(li)Right-click with an item to place it$(li)Right-click empty-handed to take it back$(li)$(l)Shift + Right-click$() empty-handed to repair ($(mana)200 mana$()) or enhance ($(mana)500 mana$())$(br2)Damaged items are repaired first; fully repaired items get enhanced instead.
